### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** fba8d7eef4143497095dcea042e4d07757f9cc78
* **Affected skills/agents/hooks:** /dso:sprint (Phase F per-worktree-review-commit + Phase F Step 18 story-branch merge), `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh`, `plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` llm-review job, `plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh` (GitHubPRDefenseStore), `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md` Phase F Step 18 (story-branch merge)
* **Triggering epic:** f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86 (Gov-copy sub-agent for empathetic, plain-language UI copy) — closed with P1=PASS verifier; PR #344 has been waiting on llm-review for >25 minutes because the review scope is the entire 47-commit epic diff instead of just the cross-story integration boundary.

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (internal-dogfood: user asked whether llm-review was accepting provenance from the per-story PRs; investigation revealed there were no per-story provenance records at all)

#### Expected Behavior

The sprint per-story merge mechanism is designed to produce two coupled artifacts whose pairing enables llm-review to scope its review to the cross-story integration surface only:

1. **`DSO-Story-Merge:`** trailer on the merge commit (written by `merge-story-branch.sh`)
2. **Per-story defense records** in the GitHubPRDefenseStore (written by per-story `/dso:review` invocations during sprint Phase F)

When both are present, the llm-review CI job (job 77743180121 in run 26409822065 for PR #344) executes its standard 5-step provenance pipeline:

```
✓ Verify session provenance
✓ Compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers
✓ Union integration review scope
✓ Compute DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE
✓ Suppress prior defenses for integration review
* Run LLM review (provenance-aware)  ← scoped to integration boundary only
```

For an epic with N stories, the review surface should be O(cross-story files) rather than O(total epic files).

#### Actual Behavior

For f360-3a5b: **all per-story merges were performed via direct `git merge <commit>` from the sprint orchestrator instead of via `merge-story-branch.sh`**. No `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailers were written for any of the 10 stories. Verified empirically:

```
$ git log --grep='DSO-Story-Merge' --oneline | head -10
aaba9f4c73 Merge story/d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6/canonical-evidence   ← prior d2f9 sprint
f3d1fc1e92 Merge story/d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6/73d7-1968-b471-485b  ← prior d2f9 sprint
... (all 10 entries are d2f9 sprint, ZERO f360-3a5b)
```

Net effect on llm-review:

* `Compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers` returns empty for f360-3a5b stories
* `Suppress prior defenses` has zero per-story defense records to suppress
* `Run LLM review` falls through to reviewing the **entire 47-commit epic diff** as a single integration surface

Symptoms:
* llm-review job has been pending >25 minutes (still running as of bug filing)
* Review surface is ~30 files vs. expected ~5 integration-boundary files
* Defense suppression doesn't apply; any finding raised against any story-internal file (not just cross-story boundary) becomes a fresh blocker

### 3. Action History

* During f360-3a5b sprint execution, `/dso:sprint` Phase F Step 18 (story-branch merge) was supposed to invoke `merge-story-branch.sh` for each closed story. It did NOT. Instead, the orchestrator merged each sub-agent isolation branch directly via `git merge worktree-agent-<id>` after the agent's work was committed.
* This happened because worktree-isolation cross-contamination caused multiple sub-agents to commit on each other's isolation branches (and sometimes on the session branch directly), creating a complex merge graph the orchestrator decided was easier to flatten with direct merges than to route through `merge-story-branch.sh`.
* The orchestrator never noticed the missing trailers because (a) Phase F Step 18 doesn't enforce that `merge-story-branch.sh` was actually called, only that the story branch was merged; (b) no post-sprint check verifies that every closed story has a `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer; (c) the completion-verifier checks story DDs against codebase state, not against merge provenance.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The fix for f360-3a5b's PR #344 itself is operational (either wait out llm-review or use `/dso:fp-recovery`). The PROCESS gaps that allowed this to happen:

**(A) sprint Phase F per-worktree-review-commit fallback was triggered too easily.** When `harvest-worktree.sh` returns a merge conflict, the documented protocol queues the conflict for post-batch resolution (rebase first, full re-implementation only as last resort). In practice, the orchestrator hit the cross-contamination pattern (agents committing to each others' isolation branches) repeatedly and resorted to plain `git merge` from the orchestrator's session worktree, bypassing harvest-worktree.sh's trailer-aware path. **Fix**: add a hard gate that blocks closing a story via Phase F Step 18 unless the most recent commit on that story branch carries a `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer (or until `merge-story-branch.sh` is invoked for the story).

**(B) merge-story-branch.sh was never explicitly invoked.** The orchestrator was supposed to call it from Phase F Step 18 in local mode (`SPRINT_MODE != ci-pr`). It did not, because the story branch's tip already pointed at the session HEAD after the direct git merges — making the invocation appear to be a no-op. **Fix**: `merge-story-branch.sh` should still be invoked even when the branch is a fast-forward; in that case it writes an empty-commit `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer marking the story closure for provenance. Sprint SKILL.md Phase F Step 18 should require this trailer creation step explicitly.

**(C) No post-sprint integrity check verifies trailers exist for every closed story.** dso:completion-verifier reads ticket DDs against codebase; it does NOT verify that closed stories have merge provenance. **Fix**: add a verifier check (Phase G Step 2 — epic-level verifier) that walks closed child stories, looks for a `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailer mentioning each story ID, and reports missing trailers in `closure_checks_results`. Block epic closure on missing trailers.

**(D) llm-review provenance pipeline silently falls through to full-diff review when no trailers are found.** This is the operational symptom; on a missing-trailer corpus, llm-review reviewing everything is a correct default for safety, but it should at minimum emit a structured warning ("No per-story DSO-Story-Merge trailers found for branch X; reviewing full diff") that surfaces in the PR check output. **Fix**: add a structured warning emit in the `Suppress prior defenses for integration review` step when zero per-story defense records are found AND the branch has multiple stories' worth of commits.

**(E) Cross-contamination during sub-agent dispatch is the root cause behind (A) and (B).** Sub-agents are dispatched with `isolation: \"worktree\"` but the harness sometimes commits to a non-isolation branch (observed via the agent's report showing the wrong branch name). This breaks the harvest-worktree.sh chain that writes `DSO-Story:` per-task trailers and ultimately `DSO-Story-Merge:` per-story trailers. **Fix is out of scope of this bug** — see also the in-flight isolation-failure bugs filed in prior sessions (worktree-agent branches showing session-branch commits, etc).

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* /dso:sprint Phase F Step 18 — make merge-story-branch.sh invocation mandatory (with explicit no-diff handling) and gate story closure on the resulting trailer
* /dso:sprint Phase G Step 2 / dso:completion-verifier — add a closure check that verifies every closed child story has a corresponding DSO-Story-Merge: trailer in the session branch history
* merge-story-branch.sh — when invoked on a fast-forward (story branch tip == session branch tip), write an empty-commit DSO-Story-Merge: trailer rather than no-op
* .github/workflows/ci.yml llm-review job — emit a structured warning when no per-story defense records found for a multi-commit session

### 6. Logs

```
$ git log --grep='DSO-Story-Merge' --oneline | head -10
aaba9f4c73 Merge story/d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6/canonical-evidence
f3d1fc1e92 Merge story/d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6/73d7-1968-b471-485b
1c72e1a0c3 Merge story/d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6/0c1d-a7d5-80ea-4914
22c3288b3f Merge story/d2f9/6db5-fea7
... (all d2f9 sprint, ZERO f360-3a5b)

$ git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD
47

$ gh run view 26409822065 --job=77743180121 | head -20
* llm-review (ID 77743180121)
  ✓ Set up job
  ✓ Run actions/checkout@v4
  ✓ Install litellm
  ✓ Smoke-test review-complexity-classifier.sh
  ✓ Verify session provenance
  ✓ Compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers
  ✓ Union integration review scope
  ✓ Compute DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE
  ✓ Suppress prior defenses for integration review
  * Run LLM review (provenance-aware)   ← pending >25 minutes
```

#### Acceptance Criteria for closing this bug

- [ ] /dso:sprint Phase F Step 18 requires merge-story-branch.sh invocation and gates story closure on the resulting DSO-Story-Merge: trailer (even when the branch is a no-diff fast-forward)
- [ ] merge-story-branch.sh writes an empty-commit DSO-Story-Merge: trailer when invoked on a fast-forward (does not no-op)
- [ ] dso:completion-verifier epic-level closure check verifies every closed child story has a DSO-Story-Merge: trailer in the session-branch history
- [ ] .github/workflows/ci.yml llm-review job emits a structured warning when zero per-story defense records are found on a multi-commit session branch
- [ ] A fixture sprint that triggers the cross-contamination pattern actually produces DSO-Story-Merge: trailers AND triggers the new Phase G integrity check on a synthetic missing-trailer branch
